about.title: Helping renters find a place they can trust.
about.subtitle: NgeKost started from a simple problem: finding a kost is exhausting. Mismatched ads, unclear prices, misleading photos. We clean all of that up.
about.missionTitle: Every kost is checked first. Only the ones that pass get listed.
about.missionBody: Our verification team reviews every property before it appears on the platform — photos, prices, and facilities. If something doesn't match, the listing doesn't go live. Simple, yet rarely done.

values.title: Verified first, listed second

values.title: The price you see is the price you pay

process.title: Owner submits the kost

process.title: Team reviews documents & photos
process.body: Ownership, location, and photo accuracy are checked one by one.

process.title: Visit or video call
